exposure.needed: whether the environment's scheduling was affected by the nodepool readiness flake at runtime (live scheduling activity and nodepool readiness timing)

original.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 fixes a scheduling flake caused by nodepool readiness (PR #6491).

decision.reason: The PR description [ev-f0215a9bf24c] says the NodePool in question did not set the group, so it remained unready. The PR and the commit change only one file, test/suites/scheduling/suite_test.go [ev-b889081063a3] [ev-28bbf8a48e60]. This is a fix to an E2E test, not a change to Karpenter's runtime behaviour, so no customer environment is exposed. A runtime-undecidable exposure wrongly suggests that real environments might be affected, and no correct exposure condition follows from a test-only change.
